assumeRoleName.description_en: The name of the RAM role to assume in the target account when multi-account access is enabled for cross-account operations
assumeRoleName.description_zh: 开启多账号访问进行跨账号操作时，扮演的目标账号 RAM角色名称

assumeRoleOverridePolicy.description_en: The access policy for role assumption
assumeRoleOverridePolicy.description_zh: 角色扮演时的权限策略

createTime.description_en: The time when the API MCP Core service was created. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard in the format of YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
createTime.description_zh: API MCP Core 服务的创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 标准的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

enableAssumeRole.description_en: Indicates whether multi-account access is enabled

enableCustomVpcWhitelist.description_en: Indicates whether the custom VPC whitelist is enabled. If not enabled, the account-level configuration is used
enableCustomVpcWhitelist.description_zh: 是否开启自定义VPC白名单，不开启则跟随账户级别的配置

id.description_en: The ID of the API MCP Core service
id.description_zh: API MCP Core 服务 ID

oauthClientId.description_en:
The custom OAuth client ID used when a custom OAuth configuration is selected.

`Only Web/Native applications are supported, and the OAuth scope must include /acs/mcp-server`
oauthClientId.description_zh:
选择自定义OAuth配置时的自定义OAuth Client ID。

`仅支持 Web/Native 应用，且 OAuth 范围必须包含 /acs/mcp-server`

publicAccessType.description_en:
The public network access type: allow public access, deny public access, or inherit account configuration. Valid values:
public: enabled.
private: disabled.
inherit: inherits the account-level configuration
publicAccessType.description_zh:
公网访问类型：允许公网访问、不允许公网访问、继承账号配置。
`public`（开启）, `private`（关闭）, `inherit`（跟随账号配置）

requiredRamPolicy.description_en: The RAM policy required to use this MCP Core service
requiredRamPolicy.description_zh: 使用该 MCP Core 服务所需的 RAM 策略

urls.description_en: The connection information of the MCP Core service
urls.description_zh: MCP Core 服务 连接信息

mcp.description_en: The streamable HTTP protocol connection information. This is the recommended option
mcp.description_zh: streamable HTTP 协议连接信息，推荐使用

vpcMcp.description_en: The streamable HTTP protocol endpoint within a VPC
vpcMcp.description_zh: VPC 下 streamable HTTP 协议连接地址

vpcSse.description_en: The SSE protocol endpoint within a VPC
vpcSse.description_zh: VPC 下 SSE 协议连接地址

vpcWhitelists.description_en: The VPC whitelists. Each value is a source VPC ID
vpcWhitelists.description_zh: 每一个限定的VPC白名单，值为来源VPC ID

items.description_en: The VPC whitelists. Each value is a source VPC ID
items.description_zh: 每一个限定的VPC白名单，值为来源VPC ID
